title: AUTO RESOLUTION CHASES YOUR FRAME CAP
why: His answer of 2026-10-25, right after the frame caps of v34.82: Yes picture quality should reduce to chase a higher cap, and Eg dynamic resolution. This reverses his 2.43 a. With a cap above 60, auto resolution now steps quality and sharpness down until the frames reach the cap, never past what the screen can show (a 240 cap on a 144 Hz screen aims at 144, a 120 cap on a 60 Hz screen keeps the old 60 rule). The game measures the screen rate from every browser frame. The 75 percent sharpness floor (his 2.44 b) still holds, and cap off still aims at 60.
now: Pick a frame cap above 60 in settings, display: when the PC falls short of it in a raid, the picture softens a step at a time (effects first, then sharpness, never under 75 percent) until the cap holds, and sharpens again when there is room. Auto resolution off keeps the picture sharp at any cap. Watch for: a softer picture at 120 to 240, and quality stepping up and down in a long fight.
